panels.title: Error Rate — Errors per Minute (LogQL)
panels.description: Counts ERROR-level log lines from user-service per minute. Spike indicates auth failures, validation errors, or upstream faults.

panels.title: Correlation ID Trace — Request Chains (LogQL)
panels.description: Streams all user-service log lines that carry a correlationId, enabling end-to-end request tracing across services.

panels.title: Feign Call Outcomes — Success vs Failure (LogQL)
panels.description: Groups user-service log lines mentioning Feign by log level over 5 m. WARN/ERROR series reveal inter-service call degradation (e.g., calls to order-service for language preference).

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate — Requests/s per Endpoint (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: http_server_requests_seconds_count | Layer 2 – Label: job=user-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: rate → sum by uri. Shows which user-service endpoints carry the most load.

panels.title: HTTP Latency Percentiles — P50 / P95 / P99 per Endpoint (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: http_server_requests_seconds_bucket | Layer 2 – Label: job=user-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: histogram_quantile at 0.50, 0.95, 0.99. A P99 spike on POST /api/auth/login indicates slow password hashing under load.

panels.title: JVM Health — Heap Usage, GC Pause Rate, Thread Count (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metrics: jvm_memory_used_bytes, jvm_gc_pause_seconds_sum, jvm_threads_live_threads | Layer 2 – Label: job=user-service, area=heap | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] for GC rate | Layer 4 – Function: sum (heap), rate (GC), gauge (threads). Memory pressure early warning — heap at 90 % triggers pre-emptive GC investigation.
